function.name: search_holy_books
function.description: Search content, chapters or authors of holy books. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

book.description: The name of the holy book.

chapter.description: The chapter number, if relevant. Default: 3

content.description: Specific content to look for, if relevant.

message.content:
A **holy book** (also called a sacred text) is a collection of writings considered divine, authoritative, and central to a particular religion or spiritual tradition. These texts often contain teachings, laws, narratives, prayers, and guidance believed to originate from or be inspired by a deity, prophet, or other transcendent source.

Key characteristics of holy books include:

| Feature | Typical Examples |
|---------|------------------|
| **Divine Origin** | Believed to be revealed by God or gods (e.g., the Bible, Qur’an). |
| **Canonical Status** | Accepted as scripture by a faith community (e.g., Torah, Vedas). |
| **Liturgical Use** | Read aloud or recited during worship services (e.g., Psalms, Bhagavad Gita). |
| **Moral & Ethical Guidance** | Provides principles for living (e.g., Ten Commandments, Hadith). |
| **Historical Narrative** | Chronicles events, stories, or genealogies (e.g., Genesis, Mahabharata). |

Examples across world religions:

| Religion | Holy Book(s) |
|----------|--------------|
| Christianity | The Bible (Old Testament + New Testament) |
| Islam | The Qur’an, Hadith collections |
| Judaism | Tanakh (Hebrew Bible), Talmud |
| Hinduism | Vedas, Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita |
| Buddhism | Tripitaka (Pali Canon), Sutras |
| Sikhism | Guru Granth Sahib |
| Jainism | Agamas, Siddha Sūtra |
| Baha'i Faith | Kitáb-i-Aqdas, Kitáb-i-Íqán |

Holy books serve multiple roles: they preserve religious history, provide moral instruction, shape cultural identity, and guide personal devotion. Their authority varies—some traditions view them as literal word of God; others see them as symbolic or allegorical guides. Regardless, they remain foundational texts for believers worldwide.
